description:
Full conditional analysis decision tree for an EXP pre-registration.

Per D-09: must specify the complete analysis plan including:
- Primary analysis (test, correction method)
- Conditional branches (if/then alternative analyses)
- Stopping rules (when to stop data collection)
- Sensitivity analyses (pre-specified robustness checks)
- Deviations require a new EXP (prevents post-hoc plan modification)

exp_id.description: EXP identifier this tree belongs to, e.g. 'EXP-042'
exp_id.title: Exp Id

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when tree was authored
created_at.title: Created At

author.description: Agent that authored this decision tree (SIG-ID agent component)
author.title: Author

primary_analysis.description: The pre-specified primary analysis. This is the analysis that will be used unless a conditional branch triggers.

conditional_branches.description: Pre-specified alternative analyses activated by conditions. Per D-09: must cover key sensitivity scenarios.
conditional_branches.title: Conditional Branches

stopping_rules.description: When to stop data collection. Required. Per D-09: must be fully specified.

deviations_require.description: Any deviation from this tree requires a new EXP, not a post-hoc amendment.
deviations_require.title: Deviations Require

sensitivity_analyses.description: Pre-specified robustness checks. Per D-09: must cover normality violations, outlier handling, variance heterogeneity at minimum.
sensitivity_analyses.title: Sensitivity Analyses

title: DecisionTree
